title: OneShot — From Request to Verified Build
classification: Demo workflow events are SIMULATED fixtures (labeled on screen) and are not current-HEAD backend evidence. Screenshots, videos, and traces are real Chromium recordings of the interactive demo at video/example/. Real-backend reference frames in screenshots/reference/ depict the API-backed live.html UI at referenceSourceCommit d10ae4d; the current React connector modal is mirrored visually from current source but is not represented as an executed backend capture.
voiceoverNote: Narration lines are suggested; the on-screen SIMULATED badge must remain visible whenever demo footage is shown.

scenes.visual: OneShot System Chat empty state; SIMULATED demo bar visible
scenes.narration: OneShot turns a single chat request into a governed, verified build.

scenes.visual: Typing the audit request, choosing capability Audit, submitting; Task Summary populates with task ID
scenes.narration: You describe the work in System Chat. The host creates a task and freezes the input — nothing runs without the host.

scenes.visual: Research worker streams evidence; findings pinned to real repository files
scenes.narration: Research gathers evidence first — every finding pinned to a real file, persisted as an artifact.

scenes.visual: Audit Discovery findings with severities (high/medium/low) in the transcript and task_audit.json
scenes.narration: Audit Discovery inspects read-only and records candidate CodeIntent — it never modifies source.

scenes.visual: Planner drafts BuildSpec; four TODOs appear and progress; host freezes build_spec.json
scenes.narration: The Planner drafts a BuildSpecification and TODOs. Only the host can freeze it.

scenes.visual: Fixture validation REJECTED banner (missing tool digest), correction pins sha256 digest, re-validation passes
scenes.narration: Independent fixture validation rejects the spec — a missing tool digest is a blocker, not a detail. Correct it, re-freeze, pass.

scenes.visual: Admission gates evaluate; direct Builder attempt denied; host issues admission_receipt.json
scenes.narration: Authorization is default-deny. The host admits exact actions and tool IDs — arbitrary tool strings grant nothing.

scenes.visual: Build executes: TODO checkboxes complete one by one, progress bar 25 to 100%, tool events stream
scenes.narration: The Builder executes admitted operations only, while the host rechecks tool identity and digest before every run.

scenes.visual: Connection settings: an invalid MCP URL fails Test Connection, the corrected HTTP URL discovers oneshot_research and source_lookup, then the model test returns provider-ready and Save preserves only non-sensitive values
scenes.narration: Connection errors surface clearly and recover. Test Connection discovers the tools before Connect, and secret fields are cleared without being recorded.

scenes.visual: Build interrupted mid-TODO-3 (failed progress), checkpoint recovery message, resume completes 100%
scenes.narration: If a worker drops mid-build, completed work is checkpointed and the resume is re-verified — no partial effects.

scenes.visual: Independent verifier streams checks, flags ordering, re-run passes 6/6; verification_report.json
scenes.narration: An independent verifier runs real end-to-end checks against the acceptance criteria. Builders never certify their own work.

scenes.visual: Completion message, all 8 stage chips green, task_summary.json final overview
scenes.narration: One request. Every stage gated, evidenced, and independently verified. That's OneShot.
